g.text: Fabric Transaction Lifecycle: Cryptographic Operations Per Phase
Signs tx proposal with client ECDSA key
Veriﬁes client sig and cert chain (MSP)
Establishes new TLS to ordering service
Signs block header with orderer ECDSA key
Broadcasts to all peers via TLS
Veriﬁes all endorsement sigs in block
Validates all cert chains (MSP) per tx
